title: A09. Orchestrarea portalului și identitatea cabinetului la inițializare
head: 2fe90ed3f128c33dff7cf9f8674e664a70679390

deployment.method: SSH read-only docker inspect and sha256sum, no endpoint call
deployment.limits: Config.User empty is a Docker-config observation, not a process UID check. Matching bind files do not prove a worker has reloaded them. Socket mount is used by existing Spree scripts and native tenant setup, and is a conditional impact amplifier, not a demonstrated arbitrary-command vulnerability.

architecture_native_first: Păstrăm Initial Tenant Setup, modelul AD_Client/AD_Org, migrarea N144 și endpointurile existente. Modificările propuse restrâng validarea și propagarea erorilor în implementările actuale.
coupling_limit: F01 și F02 sunt demonstrate separat. Nu este demonstrată într-o sesiune reală o creare de client pe targetul greșit sau ștergerea mapărilor reale.

cleanup.original_failure: SQLite context manager committed but left its final handle open; no PostgreSQL remaining
cleanup.blocked_request: Automatic exec_command policy rejected a command combining edit, recursive folder cleanup and rerun with generic blocked by policy
cleanup.residual_verified: starts.sqlite, 8192 bytes, one synthetic launches table, 6 rows, SHA 5c98952ca96b5b0890a4b7519c497da1c46e4bcebf2c602dee704922a49bc965
cleanup.coordinator_resolution: Parent verified the exact folder and sole file; non-recursive deletion of that file and now-empty folder accepted. A09 did not retry the refused recursive action.
